items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I think he was from down there somewhere. I don't remember him.

ctx.x: Well, after we left, uh, we made a trip, uh, off of Bollower Street. He'd taken me and, uh, and my mama and him and my, was it my sister? My sister, there was only three of us in there. There was seven of us all together but I was the only three living then when we went to Belize, British Honduras. Stayed about a month over there. Was it nice down there? No, that's how come we left. It was, uh, the mosquito, the sand flies was so bad down there my mama couldn't get used to them. Mm-hmm. Uh, uh, the natives down…
Did you know Issa Gere from down there? Issa Gere used to play bass. No. Excuse me. Played bass with Pierron in the 20s.
Yeah. I think he was from down there somewhere. I don't remember him.
